## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Chores**
  * Optimized Node.js memory allocation settings across build and runtime configurations.
  * Updated default backend configuration for system operations.
  * Enhanced database storage configuration settings for improved performance and capacity.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR contains configuration and runtime tuning adjustments across four files. It reduces the Node.js maximum heap size from 12 GB to 7 GB in the build script and npm package scripts, changes the default PVM backend from BuiltIn to Ananas, and adds explicit LMDB experimental options for database initialization (including mapSize, writeMap, and pageSize configuration).

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#973](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/973): Modifies the same `NODE_DEFAULTS.pvm` backend selection between PvmBackend.Ananas and PvmBackend.BuiltIn.
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#959](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/959): Adjusts Node `--max-old-space-size` values in `bin/jam/build-for-npm.sh` and `bin/jam/package.json` with different heap allocation targets.
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#967](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/967): Modifies LMDB root/database open configuration in `packages/jam/database-lmdb/root.ts` with conditional behavior changes.

**Gate `useWritemap` to avoid forcing the durability tradeoff on all modes.**

In `packages/jam/database-lmdb/root.ts`, `lmdb.open(...)` sets `useWritemap: true` unconditionally, even though `compression: !ephemeral` and `noSync: ephemeral` already gate behavior based on `ephemeral`/`readOnly`. `useWritemap` should be enabled only for the mode(s) where the reduced durability/corruption risk is acceptable (or explicitly justified with measurements).

<details>
<summary>Proposed change</summary>

```diff
     this.db = lmdb.open(dbPath, {
       // experimental options
       mapSize: 256 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, // 256G max db size
-      useWritemap: true,
+      useWritemap: ephemeral && !readOnly && process.platform !== "win32",
       pageSize: 8192,
```
</details>
